`"safe"` | `"caution"` | `"danger"` | `"unknown"` — the rule's classification
for matching items, regardless of which action kind is configured.

allOf.description: Per-rule activity aggregated over the request's time window.

call_count_window.description: Calls that fired this rule (first-match-wins, per the unified evaluator).

last_seen.description:
Most recent matching call timestamp; `None` when the rule never fired
in the window.

tool_count_window.description: Distinct wire tool names with at least one matching call.

ToolRuleListItem.description:
List-row shape — flattens [`ToolRule`] and adds activity counters scoped to
the request's [`TimeWindow`]. Activity fields are read-only: they're never
deserialised on `PATCH`, never accepted on `POST`.

action.description: The rule's action, read as stored (see `match_conditions`).

content_hash.description:
Hash of every field an approval installs; send it back on approve so
the approval installs exactly what was reviewed.

framework_refs.description:
External security-framework entries the agent cited when proposing
this rule (e.g. `["OWASP-LLM01", "CWE-78"]`). Populated only when the
expert consumed the framework knowledge pack. Display-only.

match_conditions.description:
AND-of-conditions the rule would match, so the UI renders the rule
preview without a second query. Read as stored, so a list never fails
over one row: the spec states the shape an agent writes.

proposed_rule_id.description:
Agent-minted stable rule identifier (e.g. `ASI06-01`), carried onto
the rule an approval creates.

ToolRuleView.description: The `view` a tool-rule list can ask for.

ToolRulesConfig.description:
Container for the `tool_rules` setting — wraps the array of rules so
future per-tenant knobs (e.g. rule ordering, disabled flags) have a place.

redacted_count.description: Total tool_result blocks rewritten by `replace` rules in the same window.

ToolsDedupStats.description:
Tool-definition dedup stats. Mirrors `ContentDedupStats` shape.
`total_tool_set_refs` is the sum of hash references from both
`conversation_turns.tools_available_hash` and `tools_effective_hash`.
`stored_bytes` is the deduplicated side-table payload size;
`projected_bytes` is what the in-row JSONB shape would have cost.

oneOf.description:
`null` when this key's window straddles a change of the accounting
currency.

TopUserEntry.description:
One user of the spend ranking, ordered by the shared spend rule: by what
the user spent in today's accounting currency, largest first; users with
nothing in it follow, by currency code, then by amount within one
currency. A user whose window straddles a currency change reports
`spend: null` but keeps its place by its spend in today's currency.

oneOf.description:
`null` when this user's window straddles a change of the accounting
currency.

TotalPage_A2aAgentRow.description:
Pagination with `total` — opt-in for lists where `COUNT(*)` is index-only
and under 50 ms at p99.

agent_card.description:
Cached upstream agent card (raw). Feeds the admin UI's card preview +
skill catalog; the proxy rewrites it before serving to A2A clients.

TotalPage_AdminAccountResponse.description:
Pagination with `total` — opt-in for lists where `COUNT(*)` is index-only
and under 50 ms at p99.

TotalPage_AppInfo.description:
Pagination with `total` — opt-in for lists where `COUNT(*)` is index-only
and under 50 ms at p99.

items.description: Metadata for a known AI coding client.

builtin.description: Whether this entry is built-in (true) or user-defined (false).

prompt_patterns.description:
Substrings of the opening of the system prompt (case-insensitive), tried
only when no header named the app. Each is at least
`MIN_PROMPT_PATTERN_CHARS` characters: it is tried against every
unclassified request, so a short one would claim other clients' traffic.

referer_patterns.description: Referer domain substrings used for detection (case-insensitive).

TotalPage_CatalogEntry.description:
Pagination with `total` — opt-in for lists where `COUNT(*)` is index-only
and under 50 ms at p99.

rates.description:
Price per billing unit, plus the currency those prices are quoted in.
Rates are in each unit's natural scale — per million for token units, per
single unit otherwise.

An empty map means no price is on file: the request is billed at a floor
of zero **and** badged, which stays distinct from a rate of `0`, meaning
the model is genuinely free. A catalog entry that carries only
capabilities (context window, modality support) legitimately has one.

TotalPage_EdgeNodeResponse.description:
Pagination with `total` — opt-in for lists where `COUNT(*)` is index-only
and under 50 ms at p99.

connected_instances.description:
Proxy replicas (edge instances) syncing recently: 1 for a single-proxy
VM appliance, N for a horizontally-scaled (e.g. Kubernetes) Deployment.

is_connected.description: Some proxy replica of this edge has synced recently.

last_sync_at.description: The most recent sync by any of its replicas.

status.description: `active` admits the edge's token; any other value refuses it.

synced.description:
Every live replica holds the current config, as the answering admin
replica's cache has it (at most one `EDGE_SYNC_REFRESH_MS` behind).

TotalPage_ExpertResponse.description:
Pagination with `total` — opt-in for lists where `COUNT(*)` is index-only
and under 50 ms at p99.

merge_enabled.description:
Whether this expert pools into merged analysis calls with shape-compatible
experts; `false` = always analyzed by its own solo call.

TotalPage_InviteResponse.description:
Pagination with `total` — opt-in for lists where `COUNT(*)` is index-only
and under 50 ms at p99.

TotalPage_KeyListItem.description:
Pagination with `total` — opt-in for lists where `COUNT(*)` is index-only
and under 50 ms at p99.

budget_mode.description:
`enforce` | `alert_only` — gateway keys only, meaningful when a budget is
set.

daily_budget.description:
Per-key daily budget in the tenant's accounting currency (`null` = no
per-key daily cap; always `null` for automation keys, which carry no
budget).

daily_spent.description:
Current fleet-estimate spend, in the tenant's accounting currency,
against this key's per-key budget in
the active daily / monthly windows. Filled from `usage_counters`, not a
stored column; `0` when the key carries no budget.

key_prefix.description: Masked display of key hash prefix.

kind.description:
`sk` (gateway) | `vk` (gateway BYOK) | `ak_admin` (admin control plane)
| `ak_portal` (portal control plane). The single discriminator — BYOK is
`kind == "vk"`, not a separate flag.

monthly_budget.description:
Per-key monthly budget in the tenant's accounting currency (`null` = no
per-key monthly cap).

qos_class_elevated.description:
Whether that class is more important than the workspace's — granted by
a tenant admin. `null` for automation keys.

qos_class_id.description:
The key's own priority class under load (`null` = the workspace's
class; always `null` for automation keys, which carry none).

user_id.description: The owning principal (a human user or a service account).

TotalPage_McpCatalogEntry.description:
Pagination with `total` — opt-in for lists where `COUNT(*)` is index-only
and under 50 ms at p99.

items.description: A catalog entry as returned to the admin UI.

TotalPage_McpUpstreamServerRow.description:
Pagination with `total` — opt-in for lists where `COUNT(*)` is index-only
and under 50 ms at p99.

built_in.description:
`true` for synthetic gateway-managed rows (e.g. `builtin-web` for the
built-in web-search virtual server). The admin UI surfaces a
`<SystemRowBadge>` and disables Edit/Delete for these — operators
configure them through the matching settings tab, not the upstream
CRUD form.

has_credential.description:
Presence-only signal. `true` iff `encrypted_credential`
IS NOT NULL on the underlying row. The plaintext is never echoed.

has_oauth_client_secret.description:
Presence-only signal for the encrypted client secret. `true` iff the
underlying row has a non-NULL `encrypted_oauth_client_secret`.

TotalPage_McpVirtualRouteRow.description:
Pagination with `total` — opt-in for lists where `COUNT(*)` is index-only
and under 50 ms at p99.

TotalPage_McpVirtualServerRow.description:
Pagination with `total` — opt-in for lists where `COUNT(*)` is index-only
and under 50 ms at p99.

display_title.description:
MCP 2025-11-25 `serverInfo.title` — display-friendly variant of
`name`. Clients show this in their UI; when null, falls back to
`name`. Surfaced in the `initialize` response.

oauth_enabled.description:
When true, the proxy advertises spec-compliant OAuth on this
virtual server. Unauthenticated requests return RFC 9728-compliant
`WWW-Authenticate: Bearer resource_metadata=...` headers, and
proxy-issued JWT bearers (audience-bound to the slug) are accepted.

oauth_incomplete.description:
`true` when this endpoint routes a `per_user_oauth` upstream whose
shared OAuth-App client is incomplete (missing client_id, secret,
authorization_url, or token_url). Such an endpoint can't be granted to
a workspace or connected from the portal until the client is set, so
the admin UI marks it not-grantable. Required-field set mirrors
`oauth_client_missing_fields` / `ensure_endpoint_oauth_grantable`.

sampling_credential_set.description:
Presence-only signal. `true` iff `sampling_credential` is set in DB.
The plaintext bearer is never returned over the wire.

sampling_intercept_enabled.description:
When true, server-initiated `sampling/createMessage` calls on this
virtual server are intercepted by the gateway and answered through
the standard LLM pipeline instead of being forwarded to the agent.

sampling_model_alias.description:
Model alias the synthetic LLM call requests (e.g. `claude-default`).
`None` when not yet configured.

website_url.description:
MCP 2025-11-25 `serverInfo.websiteUrl` — optional URL the client
may surface to users (e.g. linking to the product's docs).

TotalPage_ModelResponse.description:
Pagination with `total` — opt-in for lists where `COUNT(*)` is index-only
and under 50 ms at p99.

catalog_model_id.description: Explicit catalog link (NULL = auto-match by canonical name).

healing_enabled.description: Per-model self-healing override (NULL = inherit the tenant `healing_enabled`).

oneOf.description: Stored price override (null = inherit the catalog's map whole).

resolved_catalog_model_id.description: Catalog entry actually used to resolve this model (link or auto-match).

resolved_rates.description:
Price actually in force: this model's own map, else the map of the
catalog row for the SAME provider, else empty (no price known).

sources.description: Per-field provenance of the resolved value, keyed by field name.

user_overridden_fields.description: Fields the operator has explicitly pinned (caps + pricing + token limits).

TotalPage_PortalKeyInfo.description:
Pagination with `total` — opt-in for lists where `COUNT(*)` is index-only
and under 50 ms at p99.

daily_budget.description: Per-key budget ceiling (read-only here; settable by admin/manager only).

daily_spent.description:
Current fleet-estimate spend, in the tenant's accounting currency,
against this key's per-key budget in
the active daily / monthly windows. Filled from `usage_counters`, not a
stored column; `0` when the key carries no budget.

qos_class_id.description: The key's own priority class under load (`null` = the workspace's).

TotalPage_PortalMcpVirtualServer.description:
Pagination with `total` — opt-in for lists where `COUNT(*)` is index-only
and under 50 ms at p99.

built_in.description:
`true` when at least one of this virtual server's routes points at a
built-in upstream (e.g. the synthetic `builtin-web` row that backs
`/mcp/web`). Lets the portal badge the built-in web server and sort
it first in the quickstart MCP picker, regardless of its slug.

connection_status.description:
Aggregate per-user-OAuth connection state for the **current user**:
- `none` — no `per_user_oauth` upstreams (nothing to connect).
- `connected` — every `per_user_oauth` upstream has a present, unexpired
  credential for this user.
- `needs_connection` — at least one `per_user_oauth` upstream is missing
  a credential or its credential has expired. The config is still valid
  to write; the user connects in the portal to make it live.

Both the web quickstart and the `ssai` CLI surface this so a
user is warned to connect first; keep the two in sync.

requires_connection.description:
`true` when at least one of this virtual server's routes points at a
`per_user_oauth` upstream — i.e. the calling user must link their own
account in the portal before requests through this server succeed.

TotalPage_ProgramResponse.description:
Pagination with `total` — opt-in for lists where `COUNT(*)` is index-only
and under 50 ms at p99.

profile_id.description:
Transform profile scope. `None` → shared (the baseline); `Some` →
specific to that transform profile.

TotalPage_PromptSnippet.description:
Pagination with `total` — opt-in for lists where `COUNT(*)` is index-only
and under 50 ms at p99.

items.description:
Expert prompt snippet — stored one row per snippet in the `prompt_snippets`
table (keyed `(tenant_id, snippet_key)`). Shape matches the markdown
frontmatter loader at `seed_loader::SnippetEntry`.

content.description: Markdown content rendered into the agent prompt.

is_builtin.description:
True for built-in snippets that re-seed on startup; user-created snippets
(and user-edited builtins) set this false so seeds don't overwrite them.

key.description: Stable key used in expert `prompt_snippets` arrays (e.g. `memory`, `session`).

label.description: Human-readable label shown in the admin UI.

TotalPage_ProviderMeta.description:
Pagination with `total` — opt-in for lists where `COUNT(*)` is index-only
and under 50 ms at p99.

default_chat_endpoint_path.description:
Provider seed's chat-completions endpoint path override (null = canonical
`/v1/chat/completions`). Lets the UI prefill the field when a provider is
picked.

icon.description: 24x24 fill SVG path for the provider's brand glyph.

TotalPage_ProviderResponse.description:
Pagination with `total` — opt-in for lists where `COUNT(*)` is index-only
and under 50 ms at p99.

byok.description:
`true` for a BYOK pass-through downstream (keyless upstream; clients
forward their own credential, unconfigured models pass through). Granting
one to a workspace lets its members provision `vk-` keys against it.

enabled.description:
Its linked upstream server's on/off state (`true` when linked to none).
For a pass-through it is the live-grant rule: one that is not enabled
reaches nothing and is not offered for grants.

granted_workspaces.description: The workspaces whose allowlist holds this provider, by name.

is_builtin.description:
A seed-shipped pass-through: switched on and off from its server and
granted per workspace, never edited or deleted here (both answer
`409 BuiltinProviderProtected`).

workspace_count.description:
Number of workspaces whose allowlist includes this provider. Keys are no
longer provider-bound, so this measures provider reach across workspaces.

TotalPage_RoutePolicyRow.description:
Pagination with `total` — opt-in for lists where `COUNT(*)` is index-only
and under 50 ms at p99.

TotalPage_RouteResponse.description:
Pagination with `total` — opt-in for lists where `COUNT(*)` is index-only
and under 50 ms at p99.

cache_preset_id.description: Bound response-cache preset (NULL = the alias is uncached).

cache_preset_name.description: Name of the bound cache preset, for display without a second lookup.

client_slots.description: The client model slots this route fills.

disabled_reason.description:
Why the route is disabled, if it is: `upstream_model_vanished` (soft —
model gone from the provider, reinstated if it returns) or
`upstream_model_deleted` (orphan — operator deleted the model/server).

model_id.description:
Null when the route is **orphaned** — its upstream model (or server) was
deleted. The row is kept (disabled, flagged) for cleanup; see `disabled_reason`.

preset_id.description: Bound invocation preset (NULL = the model's default preset).

preset_name.description:
Resolved preset name (the route's preset, else the model's default).
NULL when the route is orphaned (no model).

qos_class_ids.description: Priority classes this target accepts; empty = every class.

resolved_context_window.description:
Resolved window/output (COALESCE'd: upstream model → catalog).
NULL = the bound model declares no value (unknown). This is the honest
real window the proxy/`GET /v1/models` advertise — distinct from
`client_context_window` (token-scaling).

TotalPage_ServerResponse.description:
Pagination with `total` — opt-in for lists where `COUNT(*)` is index-only
and under 50 ms at p99.

adaptive_concurrency.description:
Whether the gateways LEARN each endpoint's in-flight limit from its
engine's readings (KV-cache use, preemptions, prefix-cache hit rate),
`max_in_flight` being the ceiling. Excludes a waiting-queue bound; the
engines are read whatever `engine_metrics` says.

adaptive_itl_target.description:
The token-latency target the learned limit keeps each engine within:
no raise while the engine's inter-token latency is above it, and a step
down when it stays above it. `auto` (the default) is a multiple of each
engine's own time per token at low load, as the gateways learn it;
`fixed` is `ms`; `off` grows the limit as far as the engine's memory
holds.

auto_sync_enabled.description:
When on, the autosync worker periodically re-discovers this server's
models and mirrors them downstream (add + refresh + remove).

byok.description:
True when a `byok = true` pass-through downstream is linked to this
keyless upstream. Set-once at create — an update derives it solely
from the linked downstream and never flips it.

chat_endpoint_path.description:
Override for the appended chat-completions endpoint path (null = the
canonical `/v1/chat/completions`).

endpoint_count.description: How many endpoints (replicas) the server has.

endpoints_down.description:
Endpoints a connected gateway currently has out of rotation (breaker
open).

engine_metrics.description:
Whether the gateways read this server's engines' own metrics
(`/metrics`) for the dashboards. On by default for vLLM. An endpoint
with a waiting-queue bound is read whatever this says.

gated.description:
Whether the dispatch gate applies here: the server, or any enabled
endpoint of it, declares an in-flight or a waiting-queue bound. Only a
gated server has live load to report.

health.description: Whether the server can serve traffic now, from the same counts.

is_builtin.description:
A seed-shipped pass-through: it is switched on and off and repointed,
never deleted (the delete answers `409 BuiltinProviderProtected`).

last_auto_sync_at.description: Timestamp of the last autosync (or "sync now") run, if any.

oneOf.description: Outcome of the last run. Null until the first run.

max_in_flight.description:
How many requests the gateway may have in flight at one endpoint of this
server, and how long that engine's own queue may grow before it is sent
no more. Both null = the dispatch gate does not apply to this server.

scheduling_dialect.description:
How this engine expresses a request's priority class: `none` (the
default — the gateway keeps the decision to itself) or `vllm_priority`.

transport.description:
How requests are carried to this server: `default`, `azure_openai`,
`azure_openai_entra`, `aws_bedrock` or `google_vertex`.

upstream_url.description: The primary endpoint's URL: the first enabled endpoint of the server.

TotalPage_ServiceAccountKeyItem.description:
Pagination with `total` — opt-in for lists where `COUNT(*)` is index-only
and under 50 ms at p99.

items.description:
A key owned by a service account — unified across the automation (`ak-`) and
gateway (`sk-`/`vk-`) tables. `plane` discriminates; the per-plane fields are
populated only where they apply.

plane.description:
`admin` (ak-, admin control plane) | `portal` (ak-, portal control plane)
| `gateway` (sk-/vk-, data plane).

TotalPage_TenantResponse.description:
Pagination with `total` — opt-in for lists where `COUNT(*)` is index-only
and under 50 ms at p99.

TotalPage_UserResponse.description:
Pagination with `total` — opt-in for lists where `COUNT(*)` is index-only
and under 50 ms at p99.

workspaces.description:
Workspaces this user belongs to, with their per-workspace role. Populated
by the list endpoint (one batched query, not per-row); empty on the
single-row create/update responses. Lets the unified Accounts view render
the gateway side inline without an N+1 fetch. Not a DB column — skipped by
`FromRow` and filled after the query.

TraceMediaMeta.description:
Full media metadata for a trace (loaded from gateway_audit + llm_audit for media turns).
The canonical `DomainMediaCall` carries endpoint / model / input-output
blocks / params / job — plus envelope fields (provider, latency, cost) that
live on the audit row and aren't part of the call itself.

`media_call` is `Option` because a media audit row can have been written
without one — e.g., a pre-request error captured by `send_media_error_audit`
on a malformed path. Readers MUST handle `None` rather than assume the field
is populated.

oneOf.description:
What the call cost, and in which currency. A single audit row, so the
currency is whatever the ledger said when it was written — never the
tenant's current setting, which cannot restate it.

TraceResponse.description: Response for a single turn trace.

error_detail.description:
Full error detail string from `gateway_audit.error_detail` (truncated to
500 chars at capture).

oneOf.description: Media metadata from llm_audit (only for media turns)

model_used.description:
Effective model the request resolved to (echo of `llm_audit.model_used`).
Populated on the error-only fallback path so the UI can identify the
request without needing to re-read the row.

oneOf.description:
Canonical request-level parameter projection (sampling, tools catalog,
response format, metadata). Rendered as the per-turn side panel.

request_params.description: The request's sampling and wire parameters as the client sent them, in its own protocol's names.

request_tools.description:
Client-sent tools array, resolved from `tool_definitions` via the
`tools_available_hash` reference on the row. `None` when the request
had no tools (hash is NULL).

response_tool_calls.description: The tool calls the answer carried, in the client protocol's shape; `null` when it carried none.

status_code.description:
HTTP status code from `gateway_audit.status_code`. Surfaced on the trace
so error rows that never produced a `conversation_turns` entry (pre-
pipeline auth / capability / transform failures) still render a useful
"View Content" panel instead of a blank "no data" message.

tools_effective.description:
Post-policy effective tools array, resolved from `tool_definitions`
via `tools_effective_hash`. Set only when policy modified the tools
array (otherwise equals `request_tools` and is omitted to avoid noise).

TransformDiff.description: Transform diff — what the proxy changed (request + response sides).

effective_messages.description: The request's messages after transforms, when a transform changed them; `null` otherwise.

guardrail_steps.description:
Guardrail classifier findings on web tool-results folded back into the
model by the substitution loop — one entry per flagged/errored scan,
anchored by `tool_use_id`. Clean scans leave no entry. Response-phase
(substitution) data.

inbound_guardrail_steps.description:
Inline-guardrail findings on the **inbound** request surface (P1/P2) —
the user's latest message (direct injection / jailbreak) or a tool-result
the client folded into the turn (indirect injection). One entry per
flagged/errored message, anchored by a reverse message index in
`tool_use_id` so `build_events` can attach a shield banner to the exact
rendered message. Clean scans leave no entry. Request-phase data — kept
separate from the response-phase web `guardrail_steps` above so each set
attaches to the right kind of event (message vs. tool-result).

intercepted_tool_calls.description:
Model tool calls the gateway intercepted and ran server-side (web-executor
substitution). Absorbed by the agent loop — not in `response_tool_calls` —
so this is the only record of the model's intercepted call. The admin
event builder replays each as a visible `ToolCall` with an interception
banner; `tool_use_id` joins to the `web_audit` row + `guardrail_steps`.

original_response_tool_calls.description: The answer's tool calls before response-phase policy edited them.

redacted_tool_results.description:
Tool_result blocks rewritten by request-phase redaction rules. Mirrors
`blocked_tools` / `response_blocked_tools` for the result side.

response_transform_programs.description: Programs that ran in the response phase and their outcome.

oneOf.description:
Stamped on `llm_audit` rows that were synthesized by the gateway
in response to an MCP `sampling/createMessage` interception (see
`streamscope_proxy::mcp::sampling`). The pair on the originating
`mcp_audit` row is `transform_diff.sampling_intercept`. Surfaces
in the session UI as a "synthetic" affordance.

telemetry_dropped.description:
Client telemetry that was recognized at inbound but had no equivalent
on the outbound target — one entry per dropped item. Surfaces in the
session UI as a chip so the drop is visible (never silent).

Empty when the inbound and outbound protocols match (no translation
happened) or when the inbound protocol has no registered recognizers.

tool_arg_modifications.description:
Per-field rewrites of assistant tool_call arguments captured at the
response/tool_calls boundary — driven by either a tool risk rule with
`action: replace` or a Rhai response-phase script that mutates
`ctx.arguments`. The session-trace UI surfaces each entry inline on
the matching tool call.

transform_programs.description: Programs that ran in the request phase and their outcome.

TransformProgramOutcome.description:
Per-program outcome of a transform step. Replaces the prior
free-form `script:{name}` / `tr:{name}:modify` strings — the UI
reads this directly for the per-program summary in the trace viewer.

TransformProgramRef.description: Structured per-program reference for the audit trace.

id.description:
UUID of the matching `transform_programs` row. `None` when the diff
carries a name that no longer maps to a current program (renamed or
deleted) — UI renders those rows non-clickable rather than producing
a broken `/transforms/<bad-id>` link.

TransformStepDiff.description: Per-transform step diff — unified-diff-style text showing what changed.

badges.description: Typed audit badges for this turn — same shape as `AuditLogEntry::badges`.

request_id.description:
Orchestrating LLM `gateway_audit.request_id` for this turn. Surfaced
so the UI can lazy-load substitution children (web) without
a second roundtrip to fetch the request_id mapping.

oneOf.description:
The turn's charge, in the currency stamped on its audit row. `None`
when the turn has no audit row or the stamped code does not parse.

TurnParams.description:
`DomainRequestMeta` tagged with its turn number so the UI can attach the
"Request parameters" / "Tools available" side panel to the matching turn.

UnprofiledTool.description:
One unprofiled wire tool name with its call count — used to surface the
top contributors to the coverage gap on the dashboard.

card_url.description: Changing the card URL re-fetches and re-validates the card.

credential_header.description: Absent leaves it; `null` (or blank) clears it back to the default header.

description.description: Absent leaves it; `null` (or blank) clears it.

display_name.description: New display name. Absent = unchanged; explicit `null` clears it.

role.description:
Console role: `admin` or `read_only`. `is_super_admin` stays excluded —
it can never be set via the API.

UpdateAuthConfigRequest.description:
Partial update. Absent leaves a field as stored; `null` clears a nullable
one (the issuer, client id, groups and allowed domains).

oidc_client_secret.description: A write-only secret: absent or `null` keeps the stored one, `""` clears it.

UpdateCacheSettingsRequest.description:
Body for `PATCH /api/v1/admin/settings/cache`. Every field is optional —
partial updates are the norm.

embedding_alias.description:
Tri-state: absent leaves the alias alone, `null` clears it (turning
semantic matching off tenant-wide), a string sets it.

UpdateCatalogEntry.description:
A partial update to one catalog entry. Absent leaves a field as stored.
Every capability is three-state: `null` clears it back to unknown, which
lets the resolver fall back to another provider's entry rather than read a
claim nobody made.

oneOf.description:
The whole price list, replaced as one atom; absent leaves the stored map
untouched and `{}` says no price is known.

UpdateClientAccessRequest.description:
`PATCH /api/v1/admin/profiles/{id}/client-access`. Each section absent =
unchanged; a section present replaces it whole.

clients.description: The ids of the client profiles offered.

destinations.description: The destination lists the sandbox attaches, each once.

endpoint.description: The node's endpoint; an empty string clears it.

UpdateEgressSettings.description:
`PATCH /api/v1/admin/global/egress` — absent leaves a list, `null` or `[]`
empties it, a list replaces it.

UpdateExpertMembershipRequest.description:
Body for `PUT /api/v1/admin/profiles/{id}/expert`. Full replace: the listed
experts become the profile's exact member set.

color.description:
Not clearable: an expert without a colour is given one from the palette
at the next start.

merge_enabled.description:
Pool into merged analysis calls; `false` = always a solo call. Toggling
this alone does NOT detach a builtin from seed-sync.

model_override.description: Absent leaves it; `null` clears it, back to the expert profile's model.

app_filter.description:
PATCH triple-state: absent = unchanged, `null` = clear, value = set.
`double_option::deserialize` overrides serde's default outer-`Option`
collapse so `null` lands as `Some(None)` instead of being read as
"field absent".

server_type.description: Server-tool discriminator. Same triple-state semantics as `app_filter`.

expires_at.description: New expiry. Present and `null` clears it; absent leaves it unchanged.

name.description: New name for the key. Present and `null` clears it; absent leaves it.

qos_class_id.description:
The key's priority class under load. Present and `null` puts the key
back on its workspace's class; absent leaves it unchanged.

auth_mode.description:
Locked post-create — only accepted when equal to the existing value
(idempotent passthrough). Any other value rejects with
`McpUpstreamAuthModeLocked`. Each mode carries a distinct credential
shape; flips would silently strand or drop credentials.

credential.description:
Rotate the service-account bearer token. Empty string rejects with
`McpUpstreamCredentialRequired`; supplying any value on a
non-`service_account` row rejects with `McpUpstreamCredentialNotAllowed`.
Absent preserves the existing ciphertext.

description.description: `null` or `""` clears it; absent leaves it.

oauth_client_secret.description:
Rotate the OAuth client secret. Absent preserves the existing
ciphertext (no clear-via-empty-string — the resulting-shape check
would reject a per_user_oauth row without a secret).

oauth_default_scopes.description: Optional for every mode, so clearable: `null` or `[]` clears them.

oauth_revocation_url.description: Optional for every mode, so clearable: `null` or `""` clears it.

oneOf.description: As `tools_filter`.
As `tools_filter`.
Absent leaves the filter; `null` removes it (everything passes).

description.description: `null` or `""` clears it; absent leaves it.

display_title.description: A value replaces; `null` or `""` clears; absent leaves alone.

sampling_credential.description:
A write-only secret: a value replaces; `""` clears (removes the stored
bearer); absent or `null` leaves the existing ciphertext untouched.

sampling_model_alias.description: A value replaces; `null` or `""` clears; absent leaves alone.

website_url.description: A value replaces; `null` or `""` clears; absent leaves alone. Validated as `http(s)://`.

catalog_model_id.description:
The explicit catalog link (inherit from this entry): absent leaves it,
`null` clears it so the model auto-matches by name again.

healing_enabled.description: Per-model self-healing override. NULL = inherit the tenant `healing_enabled`.

oneOf.description:
Price override, replacing the catalog's map WHOLE (omitted = leave the
stored value alone; name `rates` in `reset_fields` to go back to
inheriting). An empty map is an operator saying "no price", which does
not fall through to the catalog.

reset_fields.description:
Fields to reset to inherited — clears the stored override (column → NULL)
and drops the field from `user_overridden_fields`.

client_id_metadata_url.description:
Absent = leave as-is; `null` = clear it and return the client to its
stored redirect URIs; a value = adopt (or rotate) the CIMD document.

The nesting is what makes CIMD reversible. A plain `Option` cannot tell
"field omitted" from "field explicitly cleared", so clearing it would
silently leave a third party's document authoritative for this client's
redirect URIs — with the UI reporting success.

settings.description: The preset fragment in the target model's native protocol, merged after translation; replaces the stored one.

model.description:
Judge model (`kind='expert'` only). Explicit `null` clears a
non-default profile back to inheriting the Default's model; the
Default profile's model cannot be cleared.

queue_ttl_ms.description:
Present and `null` clears the class's own TTL (back to the deployment's
default); absent leaves it as it is.

max_body_bytes.description: Not clearable: `0` falls back to the deployment-wide body limit.

rate_limit_rpm.description: Absent leaves it; `null` removes the limit.

cache_preset_id.description:
Bound cache preset — tri-state PATCH: absent = unchanged, explicit
`null` = stop caching this alias, value = bind that preset.

client_context_window.description:
The window advertised to this alias's clients — tri-state: absent =
unchanged, explicit `null` = advertise the model's own, value = that.

client_slots.description:
The client model slots this route fills — tri-state PATCH: absent =
unchanged, explicit `null` (or `[]`) = none, a list = exactly those
(each taken off the provider's route that held it).

default_for_tags.description:
Replaces the existing default-for-tags set when present. Pass `[]`
to clear.

preset_id.description:
Bound invocation preset — tri-state PATCH: absent = unchanged, explicit
`null` = reset to the model's default preset, value = bind that preset
(which MUST belong to the route's model).

qos_class_ids.description:
Which priority classes this target may serve. Replaces the set when
present; `[]` means every class, which is what every route starts as.

reassign_default_tags.description:
When a `default_for_tags` entry is already claimed by another route in
this provider, move the default to this route (clearing it from the
others) instead of rejecting. Absent / false ⇒ reject with
`RouteDefaultTagConflict` so the caller can confirm first.

tags.description: Replaces the existing tag set when present. Pass `[]` to clear.

overrides.description: Token → new override value, or `null` to clear the override.

UpdateToolRule.description:
Body of PATCH /tool-rules/{id}. Every field is optional — a missing
field means "leave as-is". `position` reorders the rule within the list
(lower = earlier) but does not promote a builtin to custom.

model_filter.description:
PATCH triple-state: absent = unchanged, `null` = clear, value = set.
`double_option::deserialize` overrides serde's default outer-`Option`
collapse so `null` lands as `Some(None)` instead of being read as
"field absent".

position.description:
Move the rule to this 0-based position in the list. Equal-priority
rules use list order as the tiebreaker so manual ordering matters.

profile_id.description:
Reassign the rule to another tool profile. Absent = unchanged. A rule
always belongs to a profile, so there is no "clear to null".

display_name.description:
New display name. Absent = unchanged; explicit `null` clears it (the
`double_option` deserializer keeps the two distinguishable).

is_active.description:
Activate/deactivate the user account. Folded from the former
`PATCH /users/{id}/status` endpoint — present for partial updates.

password.description: New password (empty string or null = no change).

UpdateWebSettingsRequest.description:
Body for `PATCH /api/v1/admin/settings/web`. Settings fields are
optional — partial updates are the norm. The `credential` field is
write-only:

- `Some("...")` (non-empty) → encrypt and store on the `builtin-web` row,
  bumping `cred_version` so the proxy's hot path picks the change up.
- `Some("")` → clear the credential (sets `encrypted_credential = NULL`).
- `None` → leave the existing credential in place.

oneOf.description:
Tri-state: absent leaves the search backend alone, `null` removes it
(`web_fetch` stays served; `web_search` is withdrawn), a value sets it.

credential.description:
Backend API key plaintext. Encrypted at rest with AES-256-GCM.
A write-only secret: absent or `null` keeps the stored one, `""` clears it.

destination_lists.description:
The destination lists the Web tool attaches, each once as allow or
block — the whole set. Absent leaves them as they are.

endpoint.description: Tri-state like `backend`: absent leaves it, `null` or `""` clears it.

engine_id.description: Tri-state like `backend`: absent leaves it, `null` or `""` clears it.

counts_toward_tenant_budget.description:
Whether this workspace's spend rolls into the tenant's org-total budget.
Absent leaves it unchanged.

fairness_weight.description:
This workspace's share of a saturated model (1–100). Absent leaves it
unchanged.

member_visibility.description:
`private` or `members` — how much of this workspace one member sees of
another in the portal. Absent leaves it unchanged.

profiles.description:
Per-kind profile choices to apply. A map entry sets that kind's
assignment three-state; a kind **absent** from the map is left unchanged.
The target profile (for `profile`) must exist in this tenant and match the
kind.

qos_class_id.description:
The QoS class this workspace's keys run as. Present and `null` clears it
back to the tenant default; absent leaves it unchanged.

UpgradeRequest.description:
Forwarded to `POST /v1/upgrade` as is. No channel and no version: the
daemon resolves the install's own channel, and `confirm` only checks what
it found.

confirm.description:
The release the operator confirmed (from `GET …/updates`): the daemon
refuses when the channel now offers another.

reboot.description:
Reboot into the new system once it is written. Otherwise the next reboot
runs it.

UpstreamSparkline.description:
One upstream's sparkline. `buckets` is aligned with the shared
`UpstreamTimeseriesResponse::bucket_starts` so the UI can render
without per-upstream timestamp lookups.

buckets.description:
Per-bucket counts, length == `bucket_starts.len()`. Zeros fill buckets
with no traffic.

key.description:
LLM: `upstream_servers.name`. MCP: `upstream_server_id` cast to TEXT.
A2A: the agent's slug. Each matches the `key` shape the matching
breakdown already returns (`BreakdownEntry` by=server,
`McpInvocationCount` pivot=upstream_server_id, `A2aBreakdownItem`
by-agent), so the two surfaces join on it.

total.description:
Total request count over the entire window. Mirrors what the breakdown
/ by-upstream callers already display next to the row.

UpstreamTimeseriesKind.description:
Audit protocol kind for the upstream-timeseries pivot. Each variant reads
its own audit child table and pivots on that protocol's notion of an
upstream: an LLM server, an MCP server, an A2A agent.

bucket_starts.description:
Bucket-start timestamps in chronological order. Shared across every
upstream so the response is compact even at top-N × ~30 buckets.

interval.description:
`"hour"` when the window is ≤ 48 hours, `"day"` otherwise. Mirrors the
granularity of `/analytics/cross/timeseries`.

upstreams.description: Top-N upstreams by total request count, descending.

UsageBreakdown.description: Usage grouped by one dimension: the top groups of the window, largest first.

UsageReport.description: This instance's monotonic cumulative per usage counter.

spend.description:
What the window spent, one entry per accounting currency its rows were
written in, each decomposed per pricing unit.

**Never empty, and one entry in the ordinary case** — read that entry as
the window's spend. A window with no priced traffic still reports a zero
in the tenant's current accounting currency, so "nothing spent" cannot be
mistaken for "spend in an unknown denomination".

More than one entry means the window straddles a change of the tenant's
accounting currency. Those subtotals are in different denominations:
report them separately, never summed.

UsageSync.description:
What admin did with the counters a [`UsageReport`] named. A counter in
neither list did not merge this time (a transient failure): the edge
restates it.

settled.description:
Counters that can never merge — a deleted tenant's, a window past
retention or out of range, a value the database refuses — dropped,
never to be restated.

totals.description: The fleet-wide total of every counter that merged.

spend.description:
What every tenant spent, one entry per currency its rows are booked in,
ordered by currency code — tenants keep their books in their own
currencies, so amounts in different ones are never added. A window
whose traffic priced nothing still lists its currency, with a zero;
the list is empty only when no tenant had traffic.

UserDetailResponse.description: User detail = the user row plus the workspaces they're a member of.

oneOf.description:
What the window cost, and in which currency. `null` when the window
straddles a change of the tenant's accounting currency.

daily_spent.description:
Current fleet-estimate spend, in the tenant's accounting currency,
against this user's override caps in
the active daily / monthly windows. Filled from `usage_counters`, not a
stored column.

set_by_email.description:
The email of whoever last set it — withheld from the portal when that
was an administrator.

set_via.description:
Who last set this exception: `admin` (the console) or `manager` (a
workspace manager in the portal); `null` when unknown.

workspaces.description:
Workspaces this user belongs to, with their per-workspace role. Populated
by the list endpoint (one batched query, not per-row); empty on the
single-row create/update responses. Lets the unified Accounts view render
the gateway side inline without an N+1 fetch. Not a DB column — skipped by
`FromRow` and filled after the query.

oneOf.description:
What this user spent over the window, and in which currency. `null`
when the window straddles a change of the tenant's accounting currency
— the rows are then in different denominations and no single figure
states them.

WebAuditLogEntry.description:
Web audit row exposed at `/audit?kind=web`. One row per
dispatched call (both direct `/mcp/web` traffic with `surface='mcp'` and
substitution-loop children with `surface='substitution'`). `parent_request_id`
links substitution rows back to the orchestrating LLM `gateway_audit`
row; the dedicated `GET /api/v1/admin/audit/{request_id}/web`
endpoint queries by it.

fetch_content_summary.description: For fetch operations: blob hashes/MIMEs into audit_media_blobs.

filter_chain.description: Ordered filter ids that ran in the chain.

parent_request_id.description:
Orchestrating LLM `request_id` when `surface == "substitution"`;
`None` for direct MCP traffic.

oneOf.description:
Provider's raw response, typed as the cap-aware
[`streamscope_core::web::audit::WebProviderResponse`]
enum. UI branches on the `Stripped` variant for the oversized
callout.

response_summary.description: Response shape returned to the caller.

result_count.description: search → hits returned to caller (post-filter); fetch → 1 on success.

oneOf.description: Per-rule diff payload (same shape the LLM/MCP rows carry).

url_results.description: Per-URL filter verdicts on every search hit / fetch target.

WebDashboardItem.description: One row in a top-N Web dashboard panel.

avg_result_count.description: Average `result_count` — populated by the `by-query` panel only.

bytes_out.description: Total response bytes — populated by the `by-host` panel only.

key.description: Pivot value: host (fetch), normalized query (search), or display name (user).

user_email.description: User email — populated by the `by-user` panel only.

user_id.description: User UUID — populated by the `by-user` panel only.

total_requests.description:
Unfiltered (pre-LIMIT) total request count across all pivot values.
Lets the UI render "N of M" without a second round trip.

blocked.description:
Calls where the policy/filter chain prevented full forwarding —
union of `web_blocked`, `web_ssrf_refused`, `web_scheme_refused`,
`web_url_filtered`, `web_all_results_filtered`, `web_rate_limited`.

domain_filter_denies.description: Subset of `blocked` where the URL-filter chain dropped at least one URL.

ssrf_blocks.description:
Subset of `blocked` where the target host resolved to a private /
loopback / link-local / IMDS address.

WebProvider.description:
Configured web-search backend. Mirrors [`crate::config::model_map::Provider`]
in spirit — string enum, snake_case wire format, parser tolerant of
shorthand forms.

oneOf.description:
Raw provider body, kept as `serde_json::Value` because the shape is
backend-specific (SearXNG wraps results, Brave/Tavily/etc each have
their own envelope).

WebProviderResponse.description:
Audit-side discriminator for the upstream provider's raw response. The
service layer caps oversized payloads at the configured KB limit; this
enum exposes the cap outcome to consumers (UI, edge → admin sync) as a
typed shape rather than free-form JSON.

Wire format is `#[serde(untagged)]` — `Stripped` matches when the JSON
carries the three discriminator fields (`stripped`, `size_bytes`,
`reason`); anything else falls through to `Captured`. The writer always
emits `stripped: true` for the Stripped variant.

WebSettings.description: Per-tenant configuration for the built-in web-search MCP.

audit_provider_response_max_kb.description:
Cap on `web_audit.provider_response` size (KB). Oversized
payloads are stored as a `Stripped` placeholder per the
"Nothing is silently discarded" invariant.

oneOf.description:
Configured search backend. `None` = no search: `web_search` is not
listed and a call short-circuits; `web_fetch` is served regardless.

endpoint.description:
Custom upstream endpoint URL. Required for SearXNG (operator-supplied
instance), optional for paid providers (override their well-known URL
— useful for regional endpoints or pen-tests against a sandbox).

engine_id.description:
Google CSE engine ID (`cx`). Required when backend is
[`WebProvider::GoogleCse`].

fetch_max_bytes.description:
Maximum bytes the built-in fetcher will read from a single response.
Larger responses abort with [`super::types::WebError::Oversized`].

max_results.description:
Default maximum hits returned by `web_search` when the caller doesn't
override. Hard upper bound: the service caps at 50 regardless.

mixed_pending_cache_ttl_seconds.description:
TTL for the cross-request mixed-pending cache, in seconds.

When an upstream turn emits both real and intercepted `tool_use`
blocks in the same round ("mixed-pending"), the agent loop
dispatches the intercepted call for audit and parks the result in
[`crate::web::MixedPendingCache`] keyed on `(tenant_id,
session_id, tool_use_id)`. The next request in the same session
drains the cache and splices the parked result into the
conversation history as a synthesised
`assistant tool_use → user tool_result` pair so the model sees what
it asked for.

Entries older than this TTL are pruned on read and on a periodic
background sweep. Set to `0` to disable cross-request splicing
entirely (mixed-pending then behaves as in step-1: dispatch +
audit + drop). Default 3600 (one hour) — long enough for a human
reading a model response and replying, short enough that a parked
search result doesn't surface days later when the conversation
has pivoted.

substitution_history_max_bytes.description:
Maximum total bytes of the cumulative `DomainRequest` body re-sent
upstream across substitution rounds. Each round splices an
`assistant tool_use` + `user tool_result` pair onto
`agent_loop_domain`, then re-serialises to the upstream protocol.
Without a cap, a long-running loop with large tool-result payloads
(e.g. several hundred KB of fetched HTML) grows the upstream body
linearly until the model's context window or the upstream's request
size limit refuses it. When this cap is exceeded mid-loop, the
agent loop drops the oldest splice (one assistant tool_use message
and the contiguous tool-result messages following it) and
re-translates, repeating up to a bounded number of passes; if still
over cap, the loop emits a
[`crate::audit::badge::AuditBadge::WebSubstitutionHistoryCap`]
audit badge plus an `injection_block` with
`reason="history_byte_cap"`, then breaks out via the existing
serialize-failed path. Default 32 MB.

substitution_max_iterations.description:
Maximum number of *substitution iterations* the agent loop may run
before forwarding the upstream's last response unmodified. An
iteration = one round of (dispatch intercepted tool calls →
re-issue upstream). With `substitution_max_iterations = N`, the
loop runs up to `N+1` upstream calls total: `N` substitution rounds
(each ending with `pending_intercepted` non-empty and
`round < N`) plus a final pass-through round. When the cap is hit
with pending intercepted calls, the loop emits
[`crate::audit::badge::AuditBadge::WebSubstitutionMaxIter`]
and forwards the upstream's last response (plus a synthetic text
marker) so the client sees something rather than an empty stream.

substitution_max_parallel.description:
Maximum number of intercepted tool-calls the substitution agent loop
dispatches in parallel within a single round. Caps the
`futures::stream::buffer_unordered` concurrency. Without this bound,
a model emitting 20+ tool_uses in one round would spawn 20+
concurrent SearXNG / paid-backend HTTP calls. Default `8` — tuned
for the SearXNG dev container's modest concurrency budget; raise
for paid backends with higher rate limits.

substitution_round_max_bytes.description:
Maximum total bytes of buffered SSE events the substitution agent
loop will accumulate within a single round before bailing out. Caps
`round_events: Vec<BufferedEvent>` so a misbehaving upstream that
emits megabytes of streaming text before a tool_use can't blow up
memory. When the cap is hit mid-round the loop forwards what's
already buffered to the client (no substitute) and emits an
`injection_block` with `reason="round_byte_cap"`. Default 8 MB.

destination_lists.description:
The destination lists the Web tool attaches: an allow list narrows the
URLs it considers to what it names, a block list removes what it names.

has_credential.description:
`true` iff the synthetic `builtin-web` row carries a non-NULL
`encrypted_credential`.

WebSettingsResponse.description:
Response for `GET /api/v1/admin/settings/web`. The settings struct
is the typed projection of `system_settings.web`; `has_credential`
is presence-only — the plaintext credential is never echoed back.

WebTestResponse.description:
Response for the test search. Wraps the raw [`SearchResult`] alongside
the `request_id` of the audit row so operators can correlate.

counts_toward_tenant_budget.description:
Whether this workspace's spend rolls into the tenant's org-total budget.
`false` takes it out of that bucket entirely — neither charged to the org
ceiling nor blocked by it — for traffic the organisation does not fund.

fairness_weight.description:
This workspace's share of a saturated model against the other
workspaces backlogged on it (1–100; 1 is the default share).

member_visibility.description:
`private` (default) — each member sees only their own usage, sessions and
audit in the portal. `members` — any member sees the whole workspace's.

qos_class_id.description:
The QoS class this workspace's keys run as unless a key names its own.
`null` = the tenant's default class.

WorkspaceClientAccess.description:
What a workspace is offered, as the provision bundle and the portal's
`client-access` answer carry it.

clients.description: The ids of the client profiles the workspace is offered.

counts_toward_tenant_budget.description:
Whether this workspace's spend rolls into the tenant's org-total budget.
`false` takes it out of that bucket entirely — neither charged to the org
ceiling nor blocked by it — for traffic the organisation does not fund.

fairness_weight.description:
This workspace's share of a saturated model against the other
workspaces backlogged on it (1–100; 1 is the default share).

member_visibility.description:
`private` (default) — each member sees only their own usage, sessions and
audit in the portal. `members` — any member sees the whole workspace's.

qos_class_id.description:
The QoS class this workspace's keys run as unless a key names its own.
`null` = the tenant's default class.

usage.description:
Current spend, in the tenant's accounting currency, for a workspace's budget
windows — the fleet-convergent
estimate from `usage_counters`, shown against the configured caps.

WorkspaceLimitsOverview.description:
Everything the workspace limits page needs to show what applies, not only
what was typed: the pool as stored, the tenant default an unset pool budget
inherits, and the member default.

member_defaults_allowed.description:
False on the Agent and Inline-AI workspaces, which take no member
default.

pool.description: The workspace pool as stored (`null` = unset).

tenant_default_daily_budget.description:
The tenant default budget a pool budget left unset inherits, in the
tenant's accounting currency (`0` = none).

active_keys.description: The member's non-revoked, non-expired keys **in this workspace**.

oneOf.description:
What the member spent in this workspace, and in which currency. `null`
when the window straddles a change of the tenant's accounting currency.

WorkspaceMembershipInfo.description:
One workspace the user belongs to, with their role in it. Surfaced on the
user-detail endpoint so admins can see (and reason about) a user's
workspace footprint without a second round-trip.

role.description:
The user's **membership** role in this workspace (`member`/`manager`),
distinct from `workspace_role` below.

bound_keys.description:
Unrevoked `vk-` keys of this workspace bound to this pass-through — what
removing the grant leaves refused until it is granted again.

enabled.description:
`false` only for a pass-through whose server is off: the grant then
reaches nothing (the gateway's live-grant rule).

WorkspaceRole.description:
A workspace's role — the single axis that governs the per-tenant singletons.

Persisted as the `workspaces.role` TEXT column (CHECK-constrained to these
four spellings; each non-`Standard` role is a per-tenant singleton via a
partial unique index). The serde/DB spelling is `lowercase`, pinned by
[`workspace_role_serde_matches_db_spelling`].

assigned_profiles.description:
Per-kind profile selections for this workspace (`workspace_profile_assignments`
joined to `profiles`). A kind with no entry runs that kind's tenant default.

role.description:
The workspace's role. `default`/`agent`/`inline` are the per-tenant
singletons the UI badges (and which are undeletable); `standard` is an
ordinary workspace. The Agent workspace wants the agent's provider(s)
granted here (manual, like any workspace); the Inline AI workspace is the
home of the built-in inline-AI service account's `POST /v1/analyze` key —
its assigned profiles are the inline analysis policy, grant it no providers.

active_keys.description:
Live (non-revoked, non-expired) portal keys this account holds in THIS
workspace.
